cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Hope with Me
cards.instruction: Recruit someone into believing that the outcome can still change, even when the evidence is thin.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Draw another route for our parade with me. Two streets said no; the town hasn't.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The only route left goes behind the supermarket.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Then take the other pencil. Can you picture people cheering by the loading bay?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My dad would come. He works there.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put him on the map. Where would a second person stand?

mechanism: A coaches its former planning pupil to develop a thin remaining parade route into a believable shared possibility.
confusable: Not denying refusal: A accepts the limited route and uses B one potential spectator to build hope concretely.
comparison: Civic route planning versus imagined café customers.
seedUse: D103 parade/supermarket/dad/map; S05 drawing and planning scaffold.
